title: Where the borders are straight: who drew the world's ruler lines, and is Africa really the straightest?
excerpt: I measured every land border on Earth. 19% is ruler-straight, and Africa holds 54% of it, but North America is straighter by share. Plus the treaties behind the 40 longest straight lines.
seo_description: Every land border in the world classified as straight, river, mountain or other, with the treaties behind the longest straight lines.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Where the borders are straight' in black on cream, beside a world map of land borders coloured by kind: red straight lines across the Sahara, Arabia, southern Africa and the 49th parallel, blue rivers, ochre mountains and grey other lines. Text: 19% of the world's land border length is ruler-straight; Africa holds 54% of it; North America is straighter by share, 46%.
